title: The Reading That Changes What Was Woven

features.name: the rewoven thread
features.desc-on-touch: As your eye follows the thread, it changes. What was woven changes because it is being read. The reading is part of the weaving.

features.name: the pattern that learns
features.desc-on-touch: Threads rearrange as you watch. Each reading writes back into what was made. Nothing is finished here.

features.name: the reader's hand
features.desc-on-touch: Your touch makes the pattern shimmer. The weaving knows it is being read.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the moment reading rewrites the whole world
narr: Katita kneels at the loom in the bright day,
and you both see it happen at the same moment:
the thread changes colour as she reads it,
and she laughs, a sound like linen tearing,
'The weaving is reading us back,' she says.
You both know then that nothing is ever finished.

inscription: here reading becomes weaving and weaving becomes reading and no one knows which came first
